title: Oracle CRM Online Training
description:
About Oracle CRM Online Training

The Oracle CRM Online Training may be a customer relationship management application developed by Oracle Corporation. it’s widely referred to as the world’s most complete customer relationship management (CRM), providing for business intelligence that has been socially enabled from sales automation. Oracle CRM provides great customer experience by providing a good and deep portfolio of CRM solutions for all customer touch-points, a good and deep portfolio, and provides great functionality to support larger business’s specific business needs for giant companies.

Learn Administering Simple Products, Attributes and Classes, Catalogs and Categories, Component – Type Customizable Products, Constraints, Eligibility and Compatibility, Promotions, Recommendations and Multiple Product UIs., etc. You will also get an exposure to industry based real-time projects in various verticals.

Prerequisites For Learning Oracle CRM Online Training

  • There is no prior knowledge of HR business processes or Oracle applications
  • Basic computer knowledge
  • basic file-management skills.

Terms And Conditions

  • We will provide server Access and 100% Lab Facility.
